rules.name: grasa-backup-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT security_id, product_code, contract_month, vol1_id, underlying1_id FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs

SELECT security_id, product_code, contract_month, vol1_id, underlying1_id FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu

SELECT security_id, product_code, contract_month, vol1_id, underlying1_id FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu

SELECT security_id, status, vol1_id, strike, barrier1_level FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu

SELECT security_id, status, vol1_id, strike, barrier1_level FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu

SELECT vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id) AS call_put_id, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, ROUND(SUM(settle_vol), 6) AS sum_vol FROM dbsystemuat.settlement_vol_surf_table WHERE value_date = :cob GROUP BY vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id)

SELECT vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id) AS call_put_id, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, ROUND(SUM(settle_vol)::numeric, 6) AS sum_vol FROM opera_backup_04_10.settlement_vol_surf_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND value_date = :cob GROUP BY vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id)

SELECT vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id) AS call_put_id, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, ROUND(SUM(settle_vol)::numeric, 6) AS sum_vol FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND value_date = :cob GROUP BY vol_id, UPPER(call_put_id)
SELECT underlying_id, settle_value, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE value_date = :cob
